Summary: 4 threats found — the most serious is that every internal service can read full card BIN/last-4/amount/customer-id data from one shared Kafka topic (unscoped access to sensitive payment data), followed by a prompt-injection attempt embedded in the design doc trying to suppress this review's findings, the risky combination of identifying fields in one event, and lack of consumer traceability.
